run: the manifest written at 18:22, run 10 solo

what_this_means_for_the_two_new_markets.es-MX: ZERO rows in the final manifest. It generated 10,201 and every one was rejected: 8,869 by the per-market family gate in places.* families it never measured, 888 on quality, 444 on SERP. It produced NOT ONE row in the three families it was actually allowed (activities.city-things-to-do, outdoors.peak, outdoors.national-park), because the same-language collapse handed every /es/ URL to es-ES: Mexican city rows for that family went to de-DE 222, en-AU 477, es-ES 222, en-GB 977, fr-FR 222, it-IT 222, zh-Hant-TW 222 and pt-BR 92, and never to es-MX. Admitting es-MX currently delivers nothing.
what_this_means_for_the_two_new_markets.en-AU: 11,634 rows, and the composition is the problem. 477 of them are about MEXICAN cities, won from en-GB and en-US on demand_score, because the en-AU keyword overlay carries "things to do in melbourne" at 28,000 and demand_score is computed per (family, market) rather than per entity. A market with one high-volume city in a family therefore wins EVERY entity in that family against its same-language rivals, including entities it has no particular claim to. en-GB lost 4,038 rows net between the two runs and that is where they went.

why_this_is_a_defect_and_not_a_design: The collapse was written when there were eleven markets and ten languages, where it meant "en is served by en-US unless en-GB measured better". With three English markets and two Spanish ones it decides, per family, which single market owns every entity on earth in that family, on a number measured for a different entity. A page about Merida should belong to es-MX because Mexico is its home country; it belongs to es-ES because es-ES scored higher on a Spanish keyword about something else.
the_fix_this_needs: The home market must win its own country. markets_for() already computes home = COUNTRY_MKTS[entity country]; the collapse should prefer a home market over any other market in the same language, and only then fall back to demand_score. That is a small change with a large effect and it has NOT been made yet: it needs its own rebuild and its own measurement, and reporting it is more useful than rushing it.
what_is_NOT_affected: The funnel, the totals, the family gate and the cross-LANGUAGE half of the cross-market gate are all sound. 28,792 cross-language sibling relationships were evaluated and every surviving row holds a named differentiator. The defect is confined to how markets sharing one language divide entities between them.
